US_entity_modes.name: Existing mosque/religious congregation qualifying under 501(c)(3)
US_entity_modes.tax_display_rule: Only display tax-deductible after organization verifies qualifying status/documentation and admin attestation.
US_entity_modes.notes: Churches, synagogues, temples and mosques that meet 501(c)(3) requirements may be automatically tax exempt without Form 1023 recognition.

US_entity_modes.name: IRS-recognized 501(c)(3) organization
verification: IRS determination/status evidence or authoritative lookup
US_entity_modes.tax_display_rule: Tax-deductibility indicator can be enabled after verification.

US_entity_modes.name: Fiscal sponsorship / qualified nonprofit intermediary
US_entity_modes.tax_display_rule: Receipts/tax claims belong to verified sponsor structure, not unverified project committee.

US_entity_modes.name: Unincorporated/new project or nonqualified recipient
US_entity_modes.tax_display_rule: Do not display tax-deductible. Allow pledges/non-tax representations only through legally supported payment flow.
